description: Reading is not activity: a person who moves the mouse and scrolls the board (wheel) continuously for two minutes, without clicking or typing, is shown to teammates as Idle at 126 s. Opening the board without clicking also shows Idle immediately (see F-048-03).
expected: Pointer movement, wheel/scroll and focus changes inside a visible tab count as activity (perhaps throttled).
actual: Only pointerdown/keydown/input count; mouse moves + wheel every 5 s still went Idle at 126 s.
suggested_fix: Add throttled pointermove/wheel/scroll listeners to the activity signal.

description: Nothing explains what Idle means or when it happens; the dashed ring on the You button has only an aria-label.
expected: The own profile says "Idle after 2 minutes without clicks or typing".
suggested_fix: Add one line of help in the profile under the state.
